📚 Tax Awareness Series | Day 24

📄 ITR-5 Explained

What is ITR-5?

ITR-5 is an Income Tax Return form used by certain entities, such as partnership firms, Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs), Associations of Persons (AOPs), and Bodies of Individuals (BOIs), subject to applicable rules.

👥 Who may need to file ITR-5?

✅ Partnership firms
✅ Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs)
✅ Associations of Persons (AOPs)
✅ Bodies of Individuals (BOIs)
✅ Certain other eligible entities

💡 Example:

If you operate a partnership firm that earns income from business, you may generally need to file ITR-5, depending on the applicable rules and your entity type.

📌 Why is ITR-5 important?

• Helps report income to the Income Tax Department
• Supports proper tax compliance
• Records income and other required financial details
• Helps taxpayers meet applicable filing requirements

🧠 Remember: ITR-5 is not meant for every taxpayer. Individuals, HUFs and companies generally use other applicable ITR forms. Certain entities may also need to use ITR-7 instead.

⚠️ Always check the latest Income Tax Department guidelines before filing your return.

✨ Right Form • Correct Filing • Stay Compliant!
